To compute $\nabla_{m,b}f$, we take partial derivatives with respect to $m$ and $b$.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\partial f}{\partial m} &=\frac{\partial}{\partial m}(mx+b)=x \\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial b} &=\frac{\partial}{\partial b}(mx+b)=1\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}\nabla_{m,b}f &=\begin{bmatrix}\frac{\partial f}{\partial m} \\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial b}\end{bmatrix} \\ &=\begin{bmatrix}x \\ 1\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
